purpose: Generates and saves plain-text outcome reports for a rally-segmentation batch CLI. Formats summary statistics and per-video outcomes from a sequence of VideoOutcome records into a human-readable report, then writes it to disk alongside the rally-spans data file.

public_api.name: VideoOutcome
public_api.role: Frozen dataclass holding the final batch outcome for one shuttle-track file: its identifier, processing status (processed/excluded/skipped), rally and contact counts, and optional failure reason.

public_api.name: format_batch_report
public_api.role: Formats outcomes into a multi-section report string showing headline status, aggregate counts by outcome type, and per-video details. Called by publish_batch_report to generate the report text.

public_api.name: derive_batch_report_path
public_api.role: Computes the output report filename next to a rally-spans CSV file by replacing the stem with a _batch_report.txt suffix. Called by publish_batch_report to determine where to save the report.

public_api.name: publish_batch_report
public_api.role: Orchestrates report generation, writing, and output: formats outcomes, derives the report path, writes the text to disk, prints it to stdout, and returns the saved path. The main entry point for callers needing a saved report.
